title: Website Tech Stack & Sitemap Intelligence Input

urls.title: Website URLs or Domains
urls.description: List of public website URLs or bare domains to profile (e.g. 'https://stripe.com', 'vercel.com'). Failed or blocked sites emit structured error records without halting the batch.

maxSitemapUrls.title: Max Sample Sitemap URLs Per Site
maxSitemapUrls.description: Maximum number of discovered sitemap URLs returned in sample_urls per site (total discovered_url_count is still counted accurately across fetched sitemaps).

followSitemapIndexes.title: Follow XML Sitemap Indexes
followSitemapIndexes.description: When enabled, traverses <sitemapindex> child sitemaps (up to 5 child sitemaps per site, including .xml.gz compressed sitemaps).

extractPublicContacts.title: Extract Public Mailto & Official Social Links
extractPublicContacts.description: When enabled, extracts public mailto: email links and official GitHub, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube links from HTML and JSON-LD sameAs.

requestDelayMs.title: Polite Delay Between Sites (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive websites. 429/503 responses automatically trigger Retry-After exponential backoff.
